title: ApexTrade
description: Normalised structured record of a single observed Apex trade, parsed from a backtest, journal, or report.

strategy.description: Internal strategy ID if identifiable from comment/magic number, else null. See docs/Strategy_Map.md.

exit.description: Exit price, if the trade has closed.

sl.description: Stop loss price. Populated either from the entry order's own SL column (if the source report has one) or, more commonly, from the closing deal's comment when MT5 records the trigger price directly (e.g. 'sl 2062.52') — see exit_reason.

tp.description: Take profit price. Populated either from the entry order's own TP column, or from the closing deal's comment when the trigger price is recorded there (e.g. 'tp 1838.47') — see exit_reason.

exit_reason.description: Why the trade closed, as literally stamped on the closing deal's comment by MT5: 'tp', 'sl', or null if the closing comment didn't match that pattern (e.g. manual close, opposite signal, end of test). Directly relevant to docs/Trailing_Stop.md and docs/BreakEven.md.

profit.description: Net profit/loss of the closing deal, taken directly from the report's Profit/Winst column. Enables real win-rate calculation per strategy (see scripts/statistics.py).

trail.description: Observed trailing distance in points/pips, if trailing behaviour was detected. See docs/Trailing_Stop.md.

comment.description: Raw order comment or magic number as recorded by MT5.

duration_minutes.description: Trade duration in minutes, derived from time/close_time.

source.description: Evidence.md ID this trade was parsed from, e.g. 'E-014' or a descriptive tag like 'backtest2025'.
